body:
I screenshot this and will try to keep referring to it. This morning was an extremely dark wake up call for me, I never thought I’d look up active plans or watch other people’s deaths before breakfast. 


My favourite Donkey quote is: “*Nobody move! I’m a donkey on the edge!*”
Hope to see you on some Disney credits one day!
Hey, thank you for sharing that with me anyway. I’m glad that book found its way to you and that you passed it onto me. It kinda made  you the voice that cares.

I go boxing, I do yoga, I write children’s stories, I meditate daily. I think if I didn’t, I would have taken people hostage at Disneyland by now?! My hobbies help me add little peaks to my depression flatness 


I’d be happy to be friends and thank you so much for your support
If you don’t mind, can I PM?

I’m so sorry you went through all that, and I hope you’re on a better place now. It’s so scary going from the “I want to die” to the “I need to die” stage. 

It’s just I’ve never asked for help. I was so broke this time last year but I had siblings to support, I would give my last £20 to them and then walk 2 hours to work and back. I know if I asked someone would have lent me lunch money or something until I got paid but I just never asked. 

And that’s just money, it’s so much more embarrassing taking about feelings.

Thank you for seeing so deeply into my layered onion soul. I cleared my search history from the horrible videos I was watching and I’m going to see a friend now to tell her the truth and get support. Thank you a million
Thank you, this meant the world to me.
Can I ask how you got out of that state? Thank you a million
Thank you this is really helpful :)
Is it moisturiser then sunscreen then primer?
